description: The SPW team at the University of Virginia publishes coarse synthetic people and activity sites for Washington state. Zenodo lists public CC BY 4.0 files including a data ZIP, README, contact matrix and validation plots. The README defines tables for household membership, residences, activity places and each person’s scheduled destination. IPUMS households, GPW population counts and OpenStreetMap-derived places appear in the input list. Such agents could help test where people are located during a regional earthquake or flood disruption simulation, after adding suitable hazard and infrastructure data. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Washington release. A limitation is that the package itself has no hazard exposure, measured movement or confirmed shelter behaviour. Its coarse activity-location synthesis cannot establish actual road congestion or emergency departure time. No ZIP or model payload was downloaded, and the geospatial coordinate system was not independently checked.
